# Rashid Media Buyer

> Rashid Khaliq (Rashid Media Buyer) is an expert media buyer and Meta ads specialist with 3+ years of experience and 100+ clients. He runs Meta (Facebook & Instagram), Google, TikTok and Snapchat ads for e-commerce brands and local service businesses (roofing, HVAC, construction, real estate, home services) in the UK, US, Canada, Australia, Europe and the Gulf. He also sets up Facebook Pixel, Conversions API, Google Tag Manager and GA4 tracking, and connects lead ads to CRMs with Zapier, Make, HubSpot and GoHighLevel.

## Services
- [E-commerce Sales Ads](https://rashidmediabuyer.com/ecommerce-ads): Meta, Google Shopping and TikTok campaigns built to sell products profitably for Shopify and WooCommerce brands.
- [Lead Generation for Local Services](https://rashidmediabuyer.com/lead-generation-ads): Qualified leads for roofing, HVAC, construction, real estate and home-service businesses, not just form fills.
- [Meta Ads Management](https://rashidmediabuyer.com/meta-ads-specialist): Ongoing Facebook & Instagram ads management: strategy, creative testing, scaling and weekly reporting.
- [Pixel, CAPI & GTM Tracking](https://rashidmediabuyer.com/facebook-pixel-setup): Facebook pixel, Conversions API, Google Tag Manager, GA4 and custom conversions set up and tested.
- [Shopify Pixel Setup](https://rashidmediabuyer.com/shopify-pixel-setup): Meta, Google and TikTok tracking on Shopify with correct purchase values and no duplicate events.
- [CRM & Lead Automation](https://rashidmediabuyer.com/crm-integration): Leads sent instantly to your CRM, inbox or WhatsApp with Zapier, Make, HubSpot or GoHighLevel.
- [Google Search Ads](https://rashidmediabuyer.com/google-ads): Search, Performance Max and Shopping campaigns that capture people already looking for what you sell.
- [TikTok & Snapchat Ads](https://rashidmediabuyer.com/tiktok-snapchat-ads): Short-form video campaigns with proper pixel and Events API tracking for younger, mobile-first audiences.
- [Performance Marketing Strategy](https://rashidmediabuyer.com/performance-marketing): One plan across Meta, Google, TikTok and Snapchat, with budget moved to whatever brings the cheapest result.

## Guides
- [Facebook Ads for Roofing Companies: A Practical Lead Generation Playbook](https://rashidmediabuyer.com/facebook-ads-for-roofing-companies): How roofing contractors can get qualified roof replacement and repair leads from Facebook and Instagram ads: targeting, lead forms, creatives, tracking and follow-up.
- [How to Set Up the Meta Conversions API on Shopify](https://rashidmediabuyer.com/meta-conversions-api-shopify): Step-by-step guide to setting up the Meta pixel and Conversions API on Shopify with the Facebook & Instagram app, maximum data sharing, deduplication and testing.
- [How to Send Facebook Lead Ads to Your CRM with Zapier](https://rashidmediabuyer.com/facebook-lead-ads-to-crm-with-zapier): Connect Facebook and Instagram lead ads to HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Google Sheets or any CRM with Zapier, plus instant WhatsApp or email alerts. Step-by-step guide.
- [Meta Ads vs Google Ads for Local Service Businesses](https://rashidmediabuyer.com/meta-ads-vs-google-ads-local-services): Should roofing, HVAC, construction and real estate businesses use Facebook ads or Google Ads? A practical comparison of intent, cost, lead quality and when to use both.
